title: Go test fixtures that push to temp repos inherit the caller's git config and fail under a read-only grade
body: Run under this attempt's GIT_CONFIG_* (url.*.pushInsteadOf -> ticfac-read-only-grade://), 20+ tests in internal/exec/subprocess and internal/reconcile fail at 'git push origin main' into their own temp bare repos; with the env removed they pass. Fixtures should scrub GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/GIT_CONFIG_KEY_*/GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL for their own git invocations, so a review or read-only attempt can run the suite it is judging.
